kultivator.screen.help.titah.title: Heavenly Decree
kultivator.screen.help.titah: The Seal of the Heavenly Decree holds four decrees: Sword, Pillar, Star and Mountain; each opens at one Dewa Abadi stage (Early, Middle, Late, Peak). Open its menu by sneaking and using the seal, through Scroll › Immortality › Heavenly Decree, or with /kultivasi titah. Pick a decree card, set Tier, Power, Damage and Speed (the server limits the values by your realm), then right-click with the seal to bring it down. Without Destruction Mode everything is visual only; the Destroy the ground coin only appears while Destruction Mode is on, and the PERMANENT stamp marks tiers that really carve the world. Each decree's film (Full, Short, Off) is set in Settings › Camera & Film.
